items.zh: 今晚打游戏吗？我新买了个手柄。
items.scene: 周五下班后在群里问大学室友

answers.en: Are you up for some gaming tonight? I just got a new controller.
answers.note: be up for 是随口邀约，适合熟人；gaming 泛指打游戏，语气轻松。

answers.en: Wanna play tonight? I picked up a new controller.
answers.note: Wanna 极口语，适合微信群里发；picked up 比 bought 随意，像顺带买的。

answers.en: Do you feel like playing tonight? I bought a new controller.
answers.note: feel like 先问对方想不想，语气最软；不带俚语，适合关系一般的朋友。

items.zh: 这关我卡了一个小时，怎么过啊？
items.scene: 周末在客厅打单机，问旁边朋友

answers.en: I've been stuck on this level for an hour. How do I get past it?
answers.note: get past it 指通过关卡，中性口语；强调时间，适合单纯求助。

answers.en: This level's had me stuck for an hour — what's the trick?
answers.note: what's the trick 是问窍门，带点服软；比直接问怎么过更像在讨经验。

answers.en: Any idea how to beat this level? I've been stuck for an hour.
answers.note: Any idea 开头像顺口征求意见，求助感弱；把卡住一小时放后面，像补充说明。

items.zh: 别送了，稳一点，我们能赢。
items.scene: 排位赛队友连续阵亡，开麦提醒

answers.en: Stop feeding and play safe — we can win this.
answers.note: feeding 是游戏术语，指不断送人头；语气直接，适合排位里急着提醒。

answers.en: Quit dying so much. Just play it safe — we've got this.
answers.note: Quit dying 更直白，像朋友间喊话；we've got this 带鼓劲，不只责备。

answers.en: Let's slow it down and stop giving them kills. We can still win.
answers.note: slow it down 指放慢节奏，整句更冷静；适合不想把队内气氛弄僵时。

items.zh: 今晚开黑吗？缺一个人。
items.scene: 晚上九点微信群喊人打五排

answers.en: We're playing tonight and need one more. You in?
answers.note: You in? 是极简邀约，适合群里点名；need one more 直接说缺一人。

answers.en: Anyone up for a game tonight? We're one short.
answers.note: Anyone up for 面向群里所有人，one short 指差一人；语气比点名更松。

answers.en: We need a fifth for tonight. Want to join?
answers.note: a fifth 专指五人队缺的第五人，玩家一听就懂；Want to join 礼貌收尾。

items.zh: 你那边好吵，能关下麦吗？
items.scene: 开黑语音里队友背景一直有电视声

answers.en: It's really noisy on your end — can you mute for a sec?
answers.note: on your end 指对方那边，mute for a sec 很客气；适合不想让队友难堪。

answers.en: Your mic's picking up a lot of noise. Can you mute it?
answers.note: picking up noise 说明麦克风收到杂音，偏技术描述；语气中性直接。

answers.en: Hey, can you mute? We can hear your TV.
answers.note: 先提要求再给原因，最直接；适合关系熟的固定队，不绕弯。

items.zh: 我掉线了，刚重连上，还在打吗？
items.scene: 游戏中途断网，重进语音问队友

answers.en: I got disconnected. I'm back — are we still playing?
answers.note: got disconnected 是中性说法，先说明再问；适合刚回到语音频道。

answers.en: My connection dropped. Just reconnected — is the game still going?
answers.note: connection dropped 具体说明网络断了，still going 问这局还继续吗；适合跟队友交代状况。

answers.en: Sorry, I lagged out. Did you guys keep going?
answers.note: lagged out 是玩家口语，带道歉；keep going 问队友有没有继续打。

items.zh: 你手机还有电吗？我手机快没电了。
items.scene: 地铁上两人用手机组队打手游

answers.en: Do you have any battery left? Mine's about to die.
answers.note: battery left 是日常问法，about to die 指快没电；语气随意，地铁里常用。

answers.en: Is your phone still alive? Mine's almost dead.
answers.note: still alive 把手机拟人化，almost dead 前后呼应；语气俏皮，适合熟人。

answers.en: How's your battery? Mine's running low.
answers.note: How's your battery 最简短，running low 指电量见底；适合关系熟、边说边看屏幕。

items.zh: 等我一下，我更新个版本，马上就好。
items.scene: 朋友催着开手游，更新快完成了

answers.en: Hang on, I'm just finishing an update. Almost there.
answers.note: Hang on 是让朋友稍等，almost there 安慰对方快好了；语气轻松。

answers.en: Give me a minute — the update's almost done.
answers.note: Give me a minute 更明确要一分钟，almost done 指更新快完成，语气中性。

answers.en: I'm updating the game. Two minutes, tops.
answers.note: Two minutes, tops 是口语保证，带点打包票；适合关系熟、对方催得紧。

items.zh: 你买的哪个版本？PS5 还是 Switch？
items.scene: 同事聊新出的游戏，问对方平台

answers.en: Which version did you get — PS5 or Switch?
answers.note: Which version 直接问版本，破折号后给选项；中性，适合同事闲聊。

answers.en: What are you playing it on, PS5 or Switch?
answers.note: playing it on 问在什么平台玩，比问版本更口语，也更具体。

answers.en: Did you pick it up on PS5 or Switch?
answers.note: pick it up 指买下这款游戏，语气随意；适合已经聊开、不用太正式。

items.zh: 这个游戏一个人玩没意思，得两个人。
items.scene: 在朋友家试玩双人合作游戏

answers.en: This game's no fun solo — you need two players.
answers.note: solo 指一个人玩，no fun 直接说没意思；适合边玩边评价。

answers.en: Playing this alone is boring. It's way better with two.
answers.note: 把 alone 和 with two 对比，强调双人才好玩；语气像个人感受。

answers.en: This one's built for two. Playing it alone gets old fast.
answers.note: built for two 指游戏本就为双人设计，gets old fast 指很快就腻；适合边玩边评价。

items.zh: 十连抽又全是垃圾，我心态崩了。
items.scene: 午休在工位抽卡，跟旁边同事说

answers.en: Another ten-pull and it's all junk. I'm losing it.
answers.note: ten-pull 是抽卡行话，I'm losing it 指快崩溃；适合跟同样玩的人吐槽。

answers.en: I did a ten-pull and got nothing but trash. What a waste.
answers.note: trash 直白，What a waste 更偏懊恼；不玩抽卡的人也听得懂，情绪没那么冲。

answers.en: Ten pulls and not one good card. I'm done.
answers.note: I'm done 是心累放弃的口气，短促；适合自嘲，不细说抽到什么。

items.zh: 你氪了多少？我这月工资快没了。
items.scene: 两个玩家在奶茶店聊抽卡游戏

answers.en: How much have you spent on this? My paycheck's almost gone.
answers.note: spent on this 是普通问法，paycheck 指工资；语气像朋友对账，不带玩家俚语。

answers.en: How much have you dropped on pulls? I'm broke till payday.
answers.note: dropped on pulls 是玩家俚语，指抽卡花掉的钱；broke till payday 更夸张。

answers.en: You spending a lot on this too? My paycheck's basically gone this month.
answers.note: 用一般问句旁敲侧击，不直接问数字；适合关系一般，语气不冒犯。

items.zh: 保底还差二十抽，要不要再充点？
items.scene: 凌晨躺床上算抽卡保底，问室友

answers.en: I'm twenty pulls from pity. Should I top up?
answers.note: pity 是抽卡保底的行话，from 表示还差；适合跟同好商量要不要充。

answers.en: I need twenty more pulls to hit the guarantee. Should I buy more?
answers.note: guarantee 指保底，buy more 指再买抽卡资源；说法比 pity 好懂，不玩的人也能跟上。

answers.en: Only twenty pulls to go before the guarantee. Worth topping up?
answers.note: Worth topping up 是自言自语式征求，带犹豫；适合半夜纠结要不要花钱。

items.zh: 昨晚那场比赛你看了吗？太精彩了。
items.scene: 早上到公司，问同样爱看比赛的同事

answers.en: Did you catch the match last night? It was amazing.
answers.note: catch 指有没有看，amazing 是普通赞叹；适合早上随口聊。

answers.en: Did you watch last night's match? What a game!
answers.note: What a game 是感叹句，情绪更足；适合两人都关注同一赛事。

answers.en: Were you watching last night? That was some game.
answers.note: Were you watching 问昨晚是否在看，some game 是口语赞叹，带回味。

items.zh: 你觉得哪队能夺冠？
items.scene: 午休和同事聊正在进行的电竞比赛

answers.en: Who do you think will take the title?
answers.note: take the title 指夺冠，中性偏正式；适合认真讨论赛况。

answers.en: Who's your pick to win it all?
answers.note: your pick 问你看好谁，win it all 很口语；适合轻松下判断。

answers.en: Which team do you see winning the championship?
answers.note: do you see 问你的判断，championship 更正式；适合不太熟的同事。

items.zh: 周末来我家玩桌游吧，我新买了两盒。
items.scene: 周四在群里约朋友来家里玩

answers.en: Come over for board games this weekend — I just bought two new ones.
answers.note: Come over 是到家来玩，board games 指桌游；直接邀约，适合群里。

answers.en: Want to come over this weekend? I have two new board games.
answers.note: Want to 先问意愿，再说有新游戏；语气比上一句软。

answers.en: I'm having people over for board games this weekend. I have two new ones to try.
answers.note: having people over 指请人来家里，强调组局做东；比前两句更像正式发起。

items.zh: 规则太复杂了，你先给我讲一遍。
items.scene: 第一次玩朋友带来的德式桌游

answers.en: The rules are way too complicated. Walk me through them first.
answers.note: walk me through 指一步步讲，way too 带抱怨；适合熟人之间。

answers.en: These rules are a lot to take in. Can you explain them before we start?
answers.note: a lot to take in 指规则太多一下消化不了，Can you 更客气；适合不太熟的朋友。

answers.en: I'm lost with these rules — give me the short version first.
answers.note: I'm lost 说看不懂，short version 要简版；适合不想听长篇规则时。

items.zh: 这局你作弊了吧？牌怎么多了一张？
items.scene: 玩卡牌桌游，发现对手手牌数量不对

answers.en: Are you cheating? How do you have an extra card?
answers.note: 直接问作弊，extra card 点出多一张；适合朋友间半开玩笑质问。

answers.en: Wait, how come you have an extra card? Did you cheat?
answers.note: 先问怎么会多牌，再补问作弊；更像发现异常后的反应。

answers.en: Something's off — you have one too many cards. Care to explain?
answers.note: Something's off 含蓄指出不对，Care to explain 带点挑衅；适合故意拿腔。

items.zh: 你玩过剧本杀吗？周末有个本缺人。
items.scene: 问新来的同事要不要一起玩

answers.en: Have you ever played a murder mystery game? We're short a player this weekend.
answers.note: murder mystery game 是英语里对应的说法，解释清楚；适合问不熟的人。

answers.en: Ever done a murder mystery? We need one more this weekend.
answers.note: Ever done 省略主语，很口语；murder mystery 简称，适合年轻人之间。

answers.en: We're doing a murder mystery this weekend and need one more — ever played?
answers.note: 先说缺人再问经验，邀请意味更强；语序随意，适合当面问。

items.zh: 我拿到凶手本了，等会儿别露馅。
items.scene: 剧本杀开场前，偷偷跟同伙说

answers.en: I got the killer's script. Don't blow our cover later.
answers.note: killer's script 指凶手角色本，blow our cover 指暴露身份；适合偷偷交代。

answers.en: I'm the murderer. Keep it together when we start.
answers.note: Keep it together 指稳住别慌，语气像提醒同伙；没具体说剧本。

answers.en: I drew the killer. Try not to blow it during questioning.
answers.note: drew 指抽到角色，blow it 指搞砸；把担心放在问答环节，更具体。

items.zh: 这个本太烧脑了，我完全没头绪。
items.scene: 剧本杀第二轮搜证，大家围着线索发愁

answers.en: This script is way too complicated — I have no idea what's going on.
answers.note: script 指剧本，have no idea 说完全懵；语气直接，适合讨论卡住时。

answers.en: My brain's fried. I can't make sense of any of this.
answers.note: My brain's fried 是口语，指脑子烧坏了；情绪更强，适合自嘲。

answers.en: This script has way too many threads. I'm completely lost.
answers.note: threads 指剧情线索，completely lost 偏中性；适合对不太熟的人说。

items.zh: 周末去钓鱼吗？我找了个新水库。
items.scene: 周五下午给爱钓鱼的朋友打电话

answers.en: Want to go fishing this weekend? I found a new reservoir.
answers.note: Want to 是随意邀约，reservoir 指水库；适合电话里直接问。

answers.en: Are you up for fishing this weekend? I have a new spot.
answers.note: be up for 更口语，spot 指钓点；不强调是不是水库，语气轻松。

answers.en: I'm going fishing this weekend — found a new reservoir. Join me?
answers.note: 先说自己的计划再邀请，Join me 更像顺带一问；适合关系熟。

items.zh: 今天一条都没钓到，白坐了一下午。
items.scene: 傍晚收竿，跟旁边钓友自嘲

answers.en: Didn't catch a single fish today. Sat there all afternoon for nothing.
answers.note: for nothing 指白坐，语气平直；适合收竿时跟钓友抱怨。

answers.en: Not even a nibble all day — what a waste of an afternoon.
answers.note: nibble 指鱼轻咬钩，连这个都没有；比上一句更生动。

answers.en: I got skunked today. Four hours and nothing.
answers.note: skunked 是钓鱼俚语，指一条没钓到；适合跟懂钓鱼的人自嘲。

items.zh: 你用的是什么相机？拍得真好看。
items.scene: 公园里看到有人拍照，上前搭话

answers.en: What camera are you using? Your shots look great.
answers.note: 先问器材再夸照片，顺序自然；适合陌生人搭话，礼貌但不过分热络。

answers.en: What gear are you shooting with? These look amazing.
answers.note: gear 指摄影器材，shooting with 是摄影圈口语；适合跟懂摄影的人搭话，显得懂行。

answers.en: That's a nice camera — what is it? The photos came out really well.
answers.note: 先夸相机再问型号，最后夸成片；更委婉，适合不想显得只关心设备。

items.zh: 我想买个相机，入门的有推荐吗？
items.scene: 午休问办公室爱摄影的同事

answers.en: I'm thinking about getting a camera. Any beginner recommendations?
answers.note: thinking about 表示还在考虑，beginner recommendations 问入门推荐；语气中性。

answers.en: I want to buy my first camera — what would you suggest for a beginner?
answers.note: first camera 强调第一次买，what would you suggest 更客气；适合认真求建议。

answers.en: Any good starter cameras you'd recommend?
answers.note: starter camera 是入门机的口语说法，句子短；适合闲聊时随口问。
